escenas.escena: Silhouette of a teenager seen from behind, sitting in a dark bedroom, lit only by the bluish glow of an old bulky CRT monitor, centered in the frame, shadows filling the corners.
escenas.animacion: The monitor glow flickers while the teenager's silhouette slowly fades away until the room is empty; the camera stays still with a very subtle push in.

escenas.escena: Close-up of an old dial-up modem on a dusty wooden desk, its small green lights glowing, a tangled phone cable trailing off, dust particles floating in the air around it.
A thumb endlessly scrolling a glowing smartphone held in a hand, the phone emerging from a huge mountain of black garbage bags piled high around it, centered composition.
A hand pulling a dusty white sheet off an old beige desktop computer stored in a cluttered attic storeroom, boxes and forgotten furniture in the background, dust swirling.
A winding river seen from above, crystal clear at the top, gradually turning murky and choked with plastic waste, old keyboards and tangled cables further downstream.
An idyllic meadow at sunset with grazing sheep, too perfect, revealed as a flat cardboard stage set propped up by wooden supports, the edges of the painted backdrop visible.
An endless row of metal filing cabinets stretching into the distance, drawers sliding open and spilling streams of gold coins onto the floor, centered in the frame.
A flowerpot on an office desk filled with a pile of banknotes, green sprouts growing out of the money, office chair and blinds softly visible behind.
Ash-covered ruins of an ancient city, broken columns and stone walls with tangled cables and circuit boards sticking out between the cracked stones, gray sky above.
An open cardboard box seen from above, holding youthful keepsakes: tangled earphones, a compact digital camera, faded concert tickets without text, a friendship bracelet, centered on a wooden floor.
A boy seen from behind lying relaxed in the grass with a small light backpack beside him; in the background an adult, also seen from behind, carrying an enormous overloaded backpack.
escenas.animacion: The adult's backpack swells and grows heavier, bending him further forward, while the boy stays still in the grass; the camera slowly pushes in toward the adult.

escenas.escena: A fogged-up bathroom mirror where a hand wipes a clear circle, revealing a blurred, unrecognizable reflection of a person behind the condensation, water droplets running down the glass.
A wall calendar in an empty room, its pages torn off and fluttering through the air like birds, blank sheets scattered across the floor, a single window letting in light.
Two anonymous hands passing a glowing smartphone across a wooden bar table, half-empty glasses and a small bowl of snacks around them, warm bar ambience behind.
